What it does

Canva is how most small trade businesses produce their own marketing material without hiring anyone. The AI features generate images, write draft copy and resize a design for every channel. The risk is generic-looking output — templates are widely recognised if used unmodified, so the branding should be adjusted.

Where the AI actually is

AI generates images, writes copy and resizes designs for each channel.

Pros

  • Free tier covers most small business needs
  • Templates for every format
  • No design skill required

Cons

  • Generic templates are recognisable if overused

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Landscapers, Remodelers & carpenters in mind. Trades producing their own flyers, social posts and quotes without a designer.
